# PatternCard

PLUS card: an optional image, content and footer on a `sunken`, `default`, or `raised` surface. - **Surface**: `sunken` (default, flat), `default` (page surface with a 1px border, flat), or `raised` (raised surface and shadow). Every card carries a 1px border (transparent on sunken and raised) so forced colors draw its edge. - **Image placement**: `top` (default), `start` or `end`. Side images apply at the large card minimum width and fill the height. `imageSplit` chooses one third (default) or one half; half uses Heading medium on a side card. Below the large minimum width, the image returns to the top with its own ratio. - **Header** (`_Card header`): `title` (the card title type, shared with Card in `styles/_card-title.scss`, one heading level below its section) over an optional `description` (Body/default 14), with `actions` at the end of the row. `header` replaces that block with custom content, like the header's `custom` type, for tabs or a toolbar. - **Spacing** comes from the Card tokens: padding uses `--card-pad` and radius uses `--card-radius` at every size, the header sits Card/stack-md above the body (`gap` picks the stack step), and the footer sits Card/stack-lg below. The footer is left-aligned. - The card hugs its content; in a row it stretches to the tallest card. - **Elevation**: a clickable `sunken` or `default` card lifts to Raised on hover in place and settles to the raised shadow while pressed; a clickable `raised` card lifts to the raised hovered step under the overlay shadow and settles back onto the raised shadow while pressed; `dragging` puts any card on the overlay pair while it moves. The card also sets the current surface, so a sticky table cell inside it matches the card.

Also asked as: summary card, object card.

**Import:** `import { PatternCard } from '@/patterns';`

## Usage

Use a card when one object needs its own container on the page. Pick `surface` by the card's role: `sunken` (default) groups static content on `--ds-surface-sunken` without a shadow; `default` pairs `--ds-surface` with a 1px `--ds-border` on the Frame, on Sunken or colored areas, and for dense rows; `raised` pairs `--ds-surface-raised` with `--ds-shadow-raised` for the one primary card per view, first in reading order. A card holds a heading, content and an optional footer for actions. Fill its slots with your own parts.

1. Pick the size by what the card holds.
2. Choose a header, or omit it when the body carries its own title.
3. Fill the body slot. Add spacing only inside slot content, using Card stack tokens.
4. Add a footer only for actions that commit.

### Color

To give a card a semantic or accent fill, swap its surface token for a solid brand (`--ds-background-brand-subtlest`, or `--ds-background-brand-bold` with `--ds-text-inverse`), status (`--ds-background-information`, `--ds-background-success`), accent-subtlest (`--ds-background-accent-teal-subtlest`), or selected (`--ds-background-selected`) background token. `surface="raised"` keeps `--ds-shadow-raised`. On a clickable colored card, hovered and pressed states use that same token's `-hovered` and `-pressed` steps.

### Size guidance

Content picks the size. Choose the smallest card that holds the content without clipping, then let the row decide how many fit. Height always hugs the content, and a card in a row stretches to the tallest card.

| Size | When to use | Pad | Radius | Minimum width | Height cap |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sm` | One number or one line. | 16 | 16 | 224 | 304 |
| `md` | A short list or a few lines. | 16 | 16 | 304 | 400 |
| `lg` | A summary with several parts. | 16 | 16 | 480 | 640 |

In Figma, `size` picks the minimum width. In code, `minWidth` sets the minimum width; every size uses `--card-pad` (16) and `--card-radius` (16). A height cap is set with `style`'s `maxHeight`, and the card clips what passes it.

### Cards in a row

In a row, place the most cards that keep each card at its minimum width. Each row is the content width of its mode, with a 16 gutter. The count switches between viewport widths of 1224 and 1256 with the sidebar docked.

| Mode | Content width | Small, 224 | Medium, 304 | Large, 480 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Medium, 768 | 720 | 3 | 2 | 1 |
| Large, 1024 | 736 | 3 | 2 | 1 |
| X-Large, 1440 | 1152 | 4 | 3 | 2 |

## Motion

PatternCard reads these motion tokens and no literal duration or curve.

| Event | Transition | Tokens | What it does | Sound |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| change | Update a value or state | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | It changes color on hover and press like a Button. Opening a clickable card is Drill. |  |
| milestone | Load content | `--ds-motion-spatial-default` | The one card in a milestone page entrance is Expressive and leaves by the exit rules. | `sound.done.milestone` on land: onboarding complete, first session, goal reached, term start or end, badge claimed; goal reached is shared, so the student hears it |

## Best practices

### Size the card to what it holds. {#size-the-card-to-what-it-holds}

Visible empty space inside the card means size down. A clipped or crowded body means size up.

Do: One number fits sm. The card is only as wide as it needs, so a row of them stays tidy.
Don't: The same number in lg leaves most of the card empty. Size down instead of filling the space.

### Never put a card inside a card. {#never-put-a-card-inside-a-card}

A card's fill and edge are its own object boundary. Group related cards in a Section instead.

Do: One card; three metrics stacked in its body, split by dividers.
Don't: Three mini cards inside the card. Borders and shadows pile up and the hierarchy flattens.

### Keep the card in place while it loads. {#keep-the-card-in-place-while-it-loads}

Do: Loading keeps the card in place: a skeleton fills the body, so the layout does not jump when data arrives.
Don't: A bare loading line takes the card away. The row collapses and everything below it moves.

### Put commit actions in the footer. {#put-commit-actions-in-the-footer}

A card that holds actions that commit a change gets a footer, and its actions start on the left, under the content. Only a modal footer aligns right.

## Accessibility

- The title is a heading one level below the section the card sits in: an h3 in a section, an h2 straight on a page. Nest the card in a Section rather than choosing a tag.
- A card that is clickable as a whole needs a role and a tab stop, and it must answer Enter and Space. When the card has one action, put a Button in the footer instead.
- Mark the card `aria-busy` while it loads. The skeleton bars are hidden from assistive technology.
- The hover lift is never the only cue that a card is clickable. Pair it with a visible action or a link in the card.
- Every card keeps a 1px border (transparent on sunken and raised) so forced colors draw its edge.
- Text sits on each surface in `--ds-text` and `--ds-text-subtle`, which meet contrast in every color mode.
- The card sets `--ds-utility-elevation-surface-current` to its chosen surface, so a sticky table cell inside it matches the card.

## Related

- Section for a region that holds cards under one heading.
- Table for many objects of the same shape that people compare across columns.
- Page for the content area's own fill, header and elevation.
- Modal for something that must be decided before the page can continue.

Same group: `AiChat` · `Blanket` · `Frame` · `Page` · `PatternModal` · `PatternSection` · `PatternSidebar` · `PatternTable`

## Parts

1. **Image** (optional). A slot above everything else, or beside the content in a side layout. It runs edge to edge, outside the pad, and the card radius clips its corners. On top, give the image you pass an aspect ratio of 16:9, 4:3 or 1:1; beside the content it fills the full height at one third or one half of the width and crops to cover.
2. **Header.** The title, an optional description and an optional actions slot. A custom `header` replaces all three. The title uses Heading xsmall at every heading level, stepping up to Heading medium for a half side image. The description uses Body default. In Figma the title truncates to one line and the description's `text` variant truncates at three lines or wraps; code leaves wrapping to CSS.
3. **Body.** A slot for text, a list or media.
4. **Footer** (optional). A left-aligned slot for actions that commit a change.

The image sits above (or, in a side layout, beside) a padded frame, and the header, body and footer sit inside it.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | `sunken` (default): `--ds-surface-sunken`, flat. `default`: `--ds-surface` with a 1px `--ds-border`, flat. `raised`: `--ds-surface-raised` with `--ds-shadow-raised`. Every surface keeps a 1px border (transparent on sunken and raised) for forced colors. |
| Hovered | A clickable card only: `sunken` and `default` lift in place to `--ds-surface-raised` with `--ds-shadow-raised`; `raised` lifts to `--ds-surface-raised-hovered` with `--ds-shadow-overlay`. A card with no `onClick` does not change. |
| Pressed | A clickable card only: settles to `--ds-surface-raised-pressed` with `--ds-shadow-raised`. |
| Focused | The card has no focus style of its own. A card made clickable as a whole takes `role` and `tabIndex` from you. |
| Disabled | A card is never disabled. Disable the controls inside it. |
| Dragging | `--ds-surface-overlay` with `--ds-shadow-overlay`, held under hover and press. |
| Loading | Skeleton bars in the body, with `aria-busy` on the card. Figma's `loading?` has no prop in code. |

### Tokens

| Token | Value | Used for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--card-pad` | 16 | Padding inside a card at every size. |
| `--card-radius` | 16 | Corner rounding of a card at every size. |
| `--card-stack-sm`, `-md`, `-lg` | 4 · 8 · 12 | Title to description; header to body, set by `gap`; body to footer. |
| `--card-inline-md` | 8 | Items on a row, such as actions in the header. |

| `--card-max-height-sm`, `-md`, `-lg` | 304 · 400 · 640 | The height cap of each size. |
| `--card-surface-sunken`, `-default`, `-raised` | color | The card fill at rest (`--ds-surface-sunken`, `--ds-surface`, `--ds-surface-raised`). |
| `--card-border-default`, `--card-border-width` | border | The 1px `--ds-border` on `default` cards, and the 1px width kept on every card for forced colors. |
| `--card-shadow-raised`, `-overlay` | shadow | `--ds-shadow-raised` on raised and hovered clickable cards; `--ds-shadow-overlay` while dragged or hovering a raised card. |
| `--card-surface-raised-hovered`, `-pressed`, `-overlay` | color | Clickable hover/press steps and the dragged overlay surface. |
| `--heading-xs`, `--card-description-font` | type | The regular title and the description (`--body-default`). |
| `--card-title-font-lg` | type | The title beside a half-width side image (`--heading-md`). |
| `--card-text`, `--card-text-subtle` | color | The title and the description (`--ds-text`, `--ds-text-subtle`). |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Title the card with the object it holds, in sentence case: "Ana Ruiz", "Sessions this week". | A generic title such as "Details" or "Info". |
| Keep the description to one line that adds something, such as "Lincoln Middle · Thu 4:00 PM". | A description that repeats the title. |
| Name a footer action for what it does: "Save note", "View session". | "OK" or "Submit". |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `id` | string | — | — |
| `title` | node | — | The card's title, in the card title type (`styles/_card-title.scss`), tagged one heading level below its section |
| `description` | node | — | Body/default 14 under the title |
| `actions` | node | — | Actions at the end of the header row: buttons, a pager or an overflow |
| `header` | node | — | Custom header that replaces title, description and actions (tabs, a toolbar) |
| `image` | node | — | Image slot, full bleed: above the content, or at the start or end edge per `imagePlacement` |
| `imagePlacement` | enum | `'top'` | Image position. Side placements apply from the large card minimum width; narrower cards put the image on top. |
| `imageSplit` | enum | `'1/3'` | Side image share. One half also steps the title up to Heading medium. Ignored for top placement. |
| `footer` | node | — | Footer slot: commit actions, left-aligned, Card/stack-lg below the body |
| `surface` | enum | `'sunken'` | Surface level: sunken (default, flat), default (page fill with a 1px border, flat), or raised (raised fill and shadow) |
| `gap` | enum | `'md'` | Header-to-body stack: Card/stack-sm · md · lg (4 · 8 · 12) |
| `minWidth` | number or string | — | Minimum width constraint (number of px or any CSS length) |
| `onClick` | func | — | Click handler, passed to the card's root element. Its presence adds the clickable class: a pointer cursor and the hover lift. It adds no role or tab stop; pass `role` and `tabIndex` for a card clickable as a whole. |
| `onKeyDown` | func | — | Key handler, passed to the card's root element. A card clickable as a whole takes Enter and Space here, beside its `role` and `tabIndex`. |
| `dragging` | bool | `false` | The card is being dragged: it lifts to the overlay pair |
| `className` | string | `''` | — |
| `style` | object | — | — |
| `children` | node | — | Body content slot |

## Variants

**`imagePlacement`** — `top` · `start` · `end`

**`imageSplit`** — `1/3` · `1/2`

**`surface`** — `sunken` · `default` · `raised`

**`gap`** — `sm` · `md` · `lg`

The named string values each prop takes. A prop's full type is in Props: a prop listed here may also take a boolean or a number, and a prop missing here may still have named values.
